svg.title: Top-face drilling saddle for rectangular aluminum tube
svg.desc: Original synthetic drill-jig layout. Hole coordinates and tolerances are in the attached CSV and context. Keepout regions show clamp occupancy, not material to generate.

g.text: Top view: two bridges, outer linking rail, central chip window
180 x 80 tube top; hole pattern 120 x 40
Front and rear clamp zones 18 long; top wall only, nominal 3
Guide bore 6.7 / body 12 / flange 18. Datum must avoid clamp zones.
Top-face drilling saddle for rectangular aluminum tube
ORIGINAL SYNTHETIC SKETCH · units mm · CSV coordinates govern · hatched regions are clamp keepouts
